name: Pilisvörösvár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Pilisvörösvár (a blue and red shield with a white eagle and a red castle gate) below the name Pilisvörösvár in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
